scope: Training-data amendment for the camera mamepa, approved by Gloria on 2026-11-13 ("Yes. Yes to all of those."). Bars in CAMERA-MAMEPA-PREREG.json and CAMERA-MAMEPA-PREREG-2.json are unchanged.
registered_before_scoring: 2026-11-13, before any training, development check or fresh clip of this hold; the chain had not started

dataset.name: DAVIS 2017 TrainVal 480p
dataset.handling: extracted by a path-checked extractor into its own private folder; frames are only decoded (JPEG via PIL); nothing in the folder is run

training.added: the 60 train sequences, every third frame encoded through the checkpoint's own vision projection; 192 clips of 32 steps joined from windows of 4-12 steps (step 0.25 or 0.5 s), a join between sequences is a cut
training.unchanged: the 384 synthetic training clips, synthetic selection split (early stopping), synthetic test split (keep rule: SSM >= 5% below persistence) and err_scale calibration on the synthetic test split
training.check_only: the 30 val sequences (48 clips): persistence and SSM loss and boundary diagnostics are reported, never used to choose, keep or calibrate anything

gates: all gates of CAMERA-MAMEPA-PREREG.json and CAMERA-MAMEPA-PREREG-2.json are scored once on the checkpoint this training produces, with their bars unchanged
